name: youtube-creator
description: YouTube creator connector for channel metrics, video management, and YouTube Analytics reports.

shortDescription.en-US: Manage videos and inspect channel analytics
shortDescription.zh-CN: 管理视频并查看频道运营数据

longDescription.en-US: Connect a Google OAuth application to inspect an authorized YouTube channel, list and manage videos, upload local media with the resumable protocol, and query watch time, traffic sources, audience demographics, and optional revenue metrics.
longDescription.zh-CN: 通过 Google OAuth 连接已授权的 YouTube 频道，读取频道与视频数据、使用可续传协议上传本地视频、修改或删除视频，并查询观看时长、流量来源、观众画像和可选收益指标。

defaultPrompt: 汇总我的 YouTube 频道数据和最近视频表现
分析最近 28 天的观看时长和流量来源
把这个本地视频以私密状态上传到 YouTube

connectors.name: YouTube Creator
connectors.description: Local MCP connector for an authorized YouTube channel and its Analytics reports.
permissions: Stores the Google OAuth client secret and OAuth session in Anybox credential storage.
Reads the authorized YouTube channel, video metadata, statistics, watch-time reports, traffic sources, audience demographics, and available revenue reports.
Uploads user-selected local video files to YouTube only after an explicit confirmed tool call.
Can update video metadata and privacy settings only after an explicit confirmed tool call.
Can permanently delete one exact YouTube video only when the destructive tool receives confirm=true.
Sends requests only to configured Google YouTube Data API, upload, Analytics, OAuth, and revocation endpoints.

configFields.label: Google OAuth Client ID
configFields.description: Client ID for a Google OAuth application with YouTube Data API v3 and YouTube Analytics API enabled.

configFields.label: Google OAuth Client Secret
configFields.description: Client secret for the Google OAuth application; it is stored in Anybox credential storage.

credential.label: Google YouTube OAuth
credential.description: Requests video-management, analytics, and monetary-report scopes for the complete initial tool set.

installReview: Create a Google OAuth web application and register http://localhost:1455/auth/callback as an authorized redirect URI.
Enable YouTube Data API v3 and YouTube Analytics API in the same Google Cloud project.
The complete initial version requests youtube.force-ssl, yt-analytics.readonly, and yt-analytics-monetary.readonly; public use may require Google OAuth verification.
Videos uploaded by unverified API projects created after July 28, 2020 are restricted to private viewing until the project passes a YouTube compliance audit.
Uploads and updates require confirm=true. Permanent deletion is irreversible and additionally marked destructive.
Revenue rows are available only when the authorized channel and Google project are eligible to access monetary reports.
